params.caption: 🎮 Cyberpunk 2077 gets multiplayer: CyberMP mod enters open beta CyberMP, a fan-made mod that lets friends explore Night City together, is now available in open beta for Cyberpunk 2077. It lands as reports suggest CD Projekt Red's in-development sequel may revisit the online ambitions the original game never delivered, a release that is likely still years away. 🕒 Nov 16, 2026 · 17:19 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👥 @CyberpunkGame · @CDPROJEKTRED 🌃 Would you run Night City with your squad? React 🔥 and tag your co-op partner 💬 #Cyberpunk2077 #CyberMP #CDProjektRed #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
